import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    p = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        p[i] = int(data[i])

    # Fenwick tree initialized with all ones
    tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        tree[i] += 1
        j = i + (i & (-i))
        if j <= n:
            tree[j] += tree[i]

    LOG = 1
    while (1 << LOG) <= n:
        LOG += 1

    res = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        k = p[i]
        # find smallest position pos with prefix sum >= k
        pos = 0
        rem = k
        for b in range(LOG, -1, -1):
            np_ = pos + (1 << b)
            if np_ <= n and tree[np_] < rem:
                pos = np_
                rem -= tree[np_]
        pos += 1
        res[pos] = i
        # remove slot pos
        x = pos
        while x <= n:
            tree[x] -= 1
            x += x & (-x)

    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, res[1:])) + "\n")

        if j <= n:
            tree[j] += tree[i]

        LOG <<= 1

    ans = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        k = P[i - 1]

        ans[slot] = i
        # mark used: subtract 1
        x = slot
        while x <= n:
            tree[x] -= 1
            x += x & -x

    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, ans[1:])) + "\n")
